signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Where is the tier for unlimited websites though?
A license key for use on a limited number of WordPress sites (as per plan).

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 0.1 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $299 regular price (80% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of our site and products after changes means you accept the revised Terms.

trials.claim: Tiers differ only by number of websites for install and use
trials.claimQuote: The only difference between the tiers is the number of websites you can install and use LinkCentral on.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show plans vary between single and multiple websites, but neither shows that website count is the only difference between tiers.

exhibits.quote: If you’re using LinkCentral on a single website, a single license will cover you. For multiple websites, you can opt for one of our other plans.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states licenses differ by single versus multiple websites, supporting tiers differ by website count.

exhibits.quote: Where is the tier for unlimited websites though?
exhibits.argument: The buyer asks about an unlimited-websites tier, confirming tiers are understood by website number.

trials.claim: Designed for affiliates and bloggers to track clicks and redirect users in WordPress
trials.claimQuote: Smarter short links for affiliates & bloggers to track clicks and redirect users easily in WordPress
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes the plugin as built for WordPress to create short links and track performance, and a blogger using affiliate marketing confirms monitoring affiliate links; the compatibility disclaimer does not undercut that purpose.

exhibits.quote: Compatibility with all WordPress themes or third-party plugins is not guaranteed.
exhibits.argument: The claim promises easy tracking and redirects in WordPress, but the vendor disclaims guaranteed compatibility.

exhibits.quote: Built for WordPress. Create smart short links, link pages, and more. Track their performance and grow your website.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes the product as built for WordPress to create short links and track performance.

exhibits.quote: As a blogger who makes money via affiliate marketing, this plugin is super helpful. I use it to monitor traffic the performance of my affiliate links.
exhibits.argument: A blogger doing affiliate marketing confirms the plugin is used to monitor affiliate link performance.

trials.claim: Can create short links, track clicks, measure goals and conversions, scan broken links, and build link pages within WordPress
trials.claimQuote: LinkCentral lets you create short links, track clicks, measure goals and conversions, scan for broken links, build link pages, and more, all within WordPress.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits support short links, link pages, tracking, and goals/conversions, but none shows broken-link scanning, so the full list of claimed features is not verified.

exhibits.quote: Even in my specific use case on a WordPress Multisite, there was a small challenge at first with correctly recognizing the clicks.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports click tracking failed initially on Multisite, contradicting the track-clicks capability.

exhibits.quote: Well, LinkCentral didn't work out of the box.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the plugin did not work on installation, undermining the claimed WordPress functionality.

exhibits.quote: Built for WordPress. Create smart short links, link pages, and more. Track their performance and grow your website.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms creating short links, link pages, and tracking performance within WordPress.

exhibits.quote: Set goals for your links to measure conversions and performance using a destination page or callback URL, including support for AWIN, Impact, and more.
exhibits.argument: The vendor confirms measuring goals and conversions for links.

trials.claim: All features are included in every AppSumo tier
trials.claimQuote: All LinkCentral features are included in every AppSumo tier.
trials.reasoning: Both the 1-site and 3-site plans list 'All premium features,' showing features are included across tiers rather than varying by tier.
